# Code of conduct

Be direct and be decent. Technical criticism is welcome and expected; personal
attacks, harassment and demeaning behaviour are not.

This project deals with adult material. Discussion stays on the software: its
architecture, its behaviour, its bugs. Content itself is not a topic here, and
requests for content, sources or material of any kind will be closed without comment.

Report problems privately to the maintainers through GitHub. Maintainers may edit,
lock, or delete contributions and may ban accounts for behaviour they judge
inappropriate.
